title: Admin walkthrough
headline: Admin walkthrough
summary: The first video in the series: how an admin sets up UniQCAI and starts a report download, recorded on the live console.
card: Sign in, brands, connections, logins, OTP mailboxes and on-demand downloads.
footer: Recorded on the working console on 28 September 2026. The “Coming next” sections are built and are being switched on for your account.

steps.title: Introduction
steps.text: One console that collects every quick-commerce report for your brands.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.text: An admin signs in with their work email and password.

steps.title: Your brands
steps.text: All client brands sit in one list. Open a brand to see its setup.

steps.title: A brand's platform connections
steps.text: Each brand shows its platform connections, split into Ads and Sales, with a live health status for every login.

steps.title: Safety check: right business only
steps.text: One portal login can hold several businesses. If the portal shows a different business than expected, UniQCAI stops rather than downloading the wrong company's data.

steps.title: Who can see this brand
steps.text: Access controls who can see a brand. Each brand team sees only its own brand and its own reports.

steps.title: Platform accounts
steps.text: Every portal login in one place. One login can serve several brands. Passwords are stored encrypted and are never shown again.

steps.title: Connect a new platform
steps.text: A guided set-up: choose the platform, add the login, choose where the verification code arrives, and pick the reports.

steps.title: OTP mailboxes
steps.text: Verification codes arrive in these mailboxes and UniQCAI reads them automatically. Nobody has to forward an OTP.

steps.title: Download reports on demand
steps.text: Choose the brand, tick the reports you need (Platform → Ads or Sales → Report), pick a date range, and start the run with one click.

steps.title: Coming next
steps.text: Run history with live progress, daily schedules, and the report library where every downloaded file is ready for your team.
